import TransposeFollowup.NativeTrimRun
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def trimValue (xs : List Bool) : Nat := xs.foldr (fun b n => b.toNat+2*n) 0
def trimBits (n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range n.size).map (fun j => n.testBit j)
def trimMarkedExact (word : Tape Bool) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (word.left.headD .blank=.start) && word.left.tail.all (fun s => decide (s=.blank)) &&
  decide (word.right.take (xs.length+1)=symbols xs++[.stop]) &&
  (word.right.drop (xs.length+1)).all (fun s => decide (s=.blank))
def nativeTrimCheck (xs : List Bool) (origin : Int) : Bool :=
  let c:=NativeTrim.cfg .scan (Counter.marked xs) (fun _ => origin)
  let r:=NativeZipper.run NativeTrim.program (4*xs.length+10) c
  decide (r.core.pc=.done) && decide (r.pos 0=origin) &&
    trimMarkedExact (r.core.tapes 0) (trimBits (trimValue xs))
def trimWords : Nat → List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (trimWords n).flatMap (fun xs => [false::xs,true::xs])
def nativeTrimTests : List Bool :=
  ((List.range 9).flatMap trimWords).flatMap (fun xs => [-17,0,41].map (nativeTrimCheck xs)) ++
  [nativeTrimCheck (List.replicate 512 false) (-93),nativeTrimCheck (List.replicate 512 true) 31,
    nativeTrimCheck ([false,true,false,true]++List.replicate 512 false) 5]
#eval (nativeTrimTests.count true,nativeTrimTests.count false)
